term: Megarian restriction of capacity to current act
definition: MegarianAbilityOnlyWhenActingReading InAct CanBe is the one-way thesis ∀ x r, CanBe x r → InAct x r. The encoded thesis says ability implies current act; it does not assert the converse. In a configuration that also uses adopted potency CanBe∧¬InAct, this leaves nothing in adopted potency. Neither that consequence nor the adopted definition alone refutes the thesis; the existing motion argument requires additional premises.
note: Grouping label for the existing thesis STMT-MEGARIAN-ABILITY-ONLY-WHEN-ACTING, not a new attribution or a claim that actualism is simply a lexical mistake. Aristotle IX.3 is preserved in its existing claim. No hypothesis identifying capacity with current exercise is imposed on adopted configurations.
